title: CAM Kernel Unification — Feature-to-G-Code in One Call
description: Wire ALL existing CAM engines (230+) into a single unified pipeline. Input: feature descriptions + material + machine name. Output: verified, physics-optimized G-code with setup sheet, tool list, physics report, and tribal knowledge tips. Leverages: 46,590 tools, 910 machines, 499 formulas, 296 playbook rules, 433 strategies, 3,700+ tribal tips, 24 novel toolpath algorithms, 11 post-processor controllers, voxel stock simulation, collision detection, 52 algorithms.
rationale: PRISM has 230+ CAM-related engines that each work individually but are not wired into a single end-to-end flow. A user must manually call feature recognition, tool selection, toolpath generation, post-processing, and verification as separate steps. This milestone connects everything into one call that produces production-ready G-code.
entry_conditions: All existing CAM engines compile (0 errors)
exit_conditions: Single dispatcher action 'cam_unified_generate' takes features+material+machine and produces G-code
Toolpath routing selects best algorithm from 24 novel + CAMKernel strategies
Post-processing outputs for all 11 supported controllers
Verification includes collision, voxel stock, safety analysis, and physics validation
Production package includes: G-code, setup sheet, tool list, physics report, tribal tips
All existing tests still pass (no regressions)
Minimum 30 new tests covering the unified pipeline

units.title: UnifiedCAMPipelineEngine — Master Orchestrator
units.description: Single entry point that chains: FeatureRecognition → SmartToolSelection → AdaptiveToolpathRouting → PostProcessing → Verification → ProductionPackage. Takes {features[], material, machine_name, controller?, options?} and returns {gcode, setup_sheet, tool_list, physics_report, tribal_tips, warnings}. Lazy-loads all sub-engines to avoid circular deps. Dispatched as 'cam_unified_generate' action.

input_schema.material: string — ISO material name or common name (e.g., 'P20', 'Ti-6Al-4V', '6061-T6')
input_schema.machine_name: string — machine from 910-machine catalog (e.g., 'DMG DMU 50', 'Haas VF-2')
input_schema.controller: string? — override controller (default: auto-detect from machine profile)
input_schema.options: {aggressiveness?: 1-10, coolant?: string, fixture?: string, multi_setup?: boolean}

output_schema.gcode: string — complete, verified, machine-ready G-code program
output_schema.setup_sheet: SetupSheet — fixture diagram, tool list, WCS, sequence, notes
output_schema.tool_list: ToolAssembly[] — selected tools with holders, from actual catalog
output_schema.physics_report: PhysicsReport — forces, power, deflection, thermal, Cpk per operation
output_schema.tribal_tips: KnowledgeTip[] — relevant tips from 3,700+ tribal knowledge base
output_schema.warnings: Warning[] — playbook violations, near-miss collisions, marginal Cpk
output_schema.cycle_time: CycleTime — estimated with P50/P75/P95 confidence intervals
output_schema.cost_estimate: CostEstimate — tool cost, machine time, energy

units.title: SmartToolSelectorEngine — Physics-Scored Tool Selection from 46K Catalog
units.description: Given feature type, material, machine limits, and tolerances, automatically selects the optimal tool from the 46,590-tool catalog. Scoring: (1) geometric fit (diameter vs feature size, flute length vs depth), (2) material compatibility (grade/coating vs ISO material group), (3) physics performance (Kienzle force, Taylor life, deflection δ=FL³/3EI), (4) machine fit (spindle speed range, power budget), (5) playbook compliance (296 rules), (6) holder availability (1,164 holders). Returns ranked candidates with rationale.
engines_to_integrate: ToolSelectionEngine — scoring with Taylor life, deflection
MachineProfilesEngine — spindle RPM range, power, taper
FormulaRegistry — Kienzle kc1.1, Taylor VT^n=C, thermal limits
KienzleForceModelEngine — force prediction per tool candidate
units.scoring_formula: score = w1*geometric_fit + w2*material_match + w3*physics_perf + w4*machine_fit + w5*playbook_score + w6*holder_avail + w7*cost_efficiency

units.title: AdaptiveToolpathRouter — Best Algorithm Selection per Feature
units.description: Routes each feature/zone to the optimal toolpath algorithm from 30+ available strategies. Decision tree: feature type × material × machine capability × tolerance → algorithm. Algorithms: CAMKernelEngine (pocket_2d, pocket_3d, contour, face, adaptive_clear, hsm), NovelToolpathEngine (TGAR for thermal-sensitive, HRAF for vibration-prone, MTHZD for multi-tool, CFSF for constant-force finishing, PTDC for deflection-compensated, VCER for chip evacuation), NovelToolpathAlgorithmsExt (12 more), CrossCamNovelAlgorithms (6 cross-CAM). Also routes to ToolpathSmoothingEngine for B-spline/corner rounding post-processing.
engines_to_integrate: CutterContactEngine — CC points on analytical surfaces (571L)

routing_logic.pocket_roughing_hard: TGAR (>45 HRC) OR VCER (chip evacuation priority)

units.title: IntegratedVerificationEngine — Collision + Voxel + Safety + Physics in One Pass
units.description: Unified verification that runs all checks in a single pass over the toolpath. Returns go/no-go with categorized issues. Checks: (1) Collision detection via CollisionIntegrationEngine (AABB+swept envelope against tool assembly, stock, fixtures, machine envelope), (2) Voxel stock simulation via VoxelStockIntegrationEngine (engagement verification, air-cut detection, residual stock), (3) G-code safety via GCodeSafetyAnalyzerEngine (24 rules), (4) Physics validation via ForceSimulationEngine (force limits, power budget, deflection), (5) Machine envelope via GCodeValidationEngine (axis limits, RPM range, feed limits), (6) Surface finish prediction via SurfaceFinishPredictorEngine.

verification_levels.WARN: Minor issues (near-miss clearance, marginal Cpk, suboptimal parameters)
verification_levels.FAIL_FIXABLE: Issues that can be auto-fixed (feed too high, wrong modal state)
verification_levels.FAIL_FATAL: Cannot proceed (collision, machine limits exceeded, gouge detected)

units.title: ProductionPackageEngine — Complete Job Package in One Output
units.description: Assembles the complete production package from all pipeline outputs. Includes: (1) G-code program (verified, post-processed for target controller), (2) Setup sheet (fixture diagram, tool list, WCS, sequence, cycle time, critical notes), (3) Tool list with actual catalog items (manufacturer, part number, dimensions, holder), (4) Physics report (forces per operation, power consumption, deflection, thermal, Cpk), (5) Tribal knowledge tips (relevant tips from 3,700+ for material/operation/machine), (6) Cost estimate (tool cost, machine time at shop rate, energy cost), (7) Cycle time with Monte Carlo confidence intervals (P50/P75/P95).
output_sections: program_header: program number, date, machine, material, programmer
setup_sheet: HTML/JSON with fixture diagram, tools, WCS, notes
tool_list: [{manufacturer, part_number, description, holder, projection, life_estimate}]
physics: [{operation, force_N, power_kW, deflection_mm, temp_C, cpk}]
